content.value: The output of an $\mathbf { A } \dot { \mathbf { D } }$ converter is applied to a digital filter with the system function, (10) $\begin{array} { r } { H ( z ) = \frac { 0 . 5 z } { z - 0 . 5 } . } \end{array}$ Find the output noise from the digital filter when the input signal quantized to have eight bits.
